description:
`${ if (@user is given) { lift

${@user.name}

} }` over a reactive `T | not` cell renders while the cell is present and re-renders when the present value changes (click #rename: "ada" → "bob"). Pre-fix (impl#1) #name stayed "ada": the group's effect returned early while the condition's truthiness was unchanged, skipping the arm's read of `@user.name`.
rationale: §7.4.2: "When `expr` references one or more reactive cells (`@x` access), the interpolation site SHALL re-render whenever any referenced cell changes — the standard reactive subscription contract". §17.1: "`if=` is sugar over `${ if(expr) { lift <element>...</element> } }`." Gap: g-impl1-markup-if-branch-memo-stale-render-s462.
